evidence_type: One owner-authorized local acceptance run; not an adoption-rate benchmark

orca.launch: Hidden Electron renderer; ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH=1; Playwright CDP
orca.panel_source: Draft https://github.com/yongjip/orca/pull/1 at b6ab6b700233; not a claim about the released Orca UI

mergetrain.plugin_source: Local codex/orca-real-agents checkout, based on aa43b778a565c5380cf198a0c1cfc559516b761e

workflow: Committed control configuration and gates before task worktrees
Each model read actual MCP status, implemented its own feature and edge-case tests, committed a clean branch, enqueued through MCP, then stopped
Operator clicked Validate queue in Orca after all three jobs were waiting

findings.python_selection: Codex 0.133.0 diagnostic did not forward UV_PYTHON to MCP. Explicit uvx --python >=3.10 matches the package requirement and avoids default Python 3.9.6. The final successful run used Codex 0.162.1.
findings.cold_start: Cold dependencies exceeded a 30-second MCP startup limit. Warmed the exact pinned runtime before the successful fresh sessions.
findings.claude_connection_cache: A failed connection was cached for about 15 minutes during a preliminary attempt.
findings.agy_plugin_only: Plugin inventory showed a skill and MCP component, but the interactive session did not expose the tools until explicit agy mcp add registration before startup.
findings.agy_permissions: This account did not support mode auto. The real task used accept-edits and individual approvals; no bypass flag or persistent approval rule.
findings.authentication: Existing logins reused with owner permission. Temporary Codex auth and Claude OAuth copies excluded from evidence and deleted; Agy native profile reused without publishing credentials.

other_checks.published_registry_startup: initialize, five tools, empty deploy approval inputs; passed with UV_PYTHON set to system Python 3.9

limits: CLI sessions in Orca terminals; structured chat clients were not tested
macOS only; Windows, WSL and SSH were not tested
Agy required explicit server registration and task-scoped interactive approvals
Default plugin-only Agy MCP loading is not claimed as working
No deployment or GitHub push was performed
Queue UI validation used the draft Orca integration build
